source_semantics.review: Individually review all four complete files and ten hunks of the original leaf aria-expanded fix. CdkTreeNode gains a public isLeafNode getter: a provided isExpandable callback returning false identifies a flat leaf, otherwise zero descendants identifies a nested leaf. The host binding returns null for leaves and the actual expansion state for nonleaves. Exact changed CDK/Material assertions expect null on leaves and false/true on expandable nodes; one recursive nested-tree callback additionally marks for check. All59 cases retain identity and54 complete callbacks are unchanged. The full runtime projection preserves all remaining operations beyond that getter and host field; the complete original API reference records the added getter. The owned add-on has no tree implementation, imports, reexports, dynamic imports, require routes, tree markup or tree fork across its entire1028 source members, independently sealed by the1141-member product guard. These are public peer tree changes outside retained legacy scope; do not transplant them into unrelated legacy components, update a golden, or fabricate an executed peer path. Native a11y/lifecycle/floor equivalence is not claimed.
